description: [DREAL OCCITANIE] Projets photovoltaiques en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by picto-occitanie.fr. A solar photovoltaic system consists of two elements: photovoltaic modules to transform the radiative energy of the sun into electricity an electronic device called inverter so that this DC electricity is converted into alternating current and compatible with the distributed current. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL OCCITANIA] Photovoltaic projects in Occitania" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
